headline.en: Barcelona have seven goals and none conceded before Rayo
headline.es: El Barca lleva siete goles y cero encajados antes del Rayo

summary.en: After Elche and Athletic, Barcelona have scored seven and conceded none. Those two games were different. Rayo defend in a low block. Monday at 21:30 is the first time this start meets a team set up to sit in.
summary.es: Siete a favor y cero en contra. El Rayo se cierra. El lunes a las 21:30 es otra prueba.

body.en: Elche lost 5-0. Athletic lost 2-0 and still needed Unai Simon to keep the score down. Combined, that is seven scored and none conceded. Rayo will not play like either of those sides. They defend deep and look for space behind the full-backs. Flick has to decide the left-back, the left winger, and whether anyone plays as a closer striker. Two wins do not guarantee a third. Monday is simply the first low-block test of the season. If Barcelona still create chances, the start is solid. If they spend an hour passing in front of the box, Athletic was the easier night.

headline.en: Flick has the press from his first season back. October will test it
headline.es: Flick ha recuperado la presion de su primer ano. Octubre lo examina

summary.en: Mundo Deportivo said the first two Liga games look like Flick's first season: high press, quick attacks. In October Barcelona go to Galatasaray and Paris in consecutive weeks. Raphinha, Pedri and Yamal will need help in those games.
summary.es: Los dos primeros partidos se parecen a la primera temporada de Flick. En octubre hay Galatasaray y PSG fuera.

body.en: The first two Liga matches have been vertical and aggressive. Mundo Deportivo compared them to Flick's first season. The press needs bodies. Rodri is still in the gym. Gavi missed Saturday. Pedri has started. Gordon can run when Raphinha needs rest. In October the calendar sends Barcelona to Galatasaray and Paris in consecutive weeks. If those players are fit, the comparison holds. If they are not, Barcelona will try the same press with fewer people. The idea is already visible. The test is whether the squad can play it three times in eight days later in the autumn.

headline.en: Yamal played an hour at Elche and 90 minutes against Athletic
headline.es: Yamal jugo una hora en Elche y 90 minutos ante el Athletic

summary.en: Flick said after Elche that Yamal had three weeks off, trained for a few days, and still played about an hour. Against Athletic he played the full match and hit the post. Luis de la Fuente has talked about calling him back to Spain.
summary.es: Flick dijo que Yamal venia de tres semanas libres y jugo una hora en Elche. Ante el Athletic completo el partido. De la Fuente habla de la seleccion.

body.en: Yamal's minutes went from about 60 at Elche to 90 against Athletic in four days. He created chances and hit the post. He did not score. Flick had already said the holiday was three weeks and the training time since then was short. Spain may call him. Barcelona play Rayo on Monday and Feyenoord on 9 September at 18:45. The staff can still keep the next step smaller. They can also play him for another full match and then a midweek. There is no injury bulletin. The only decision is the number of minutes this week. A Liga goal can wait. Another jump from 90 to a full European night, with Spain in between, is the thing to watch.
